To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Republic of Moldovas Association with EU is based on a political and economic basis.
the Republic of Moldovan SMEs are not prepared for the Association Agreement with the European Union, and the Republic of Chisinau should be more active in the implementation of this Agreement.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following issues: the strategy and the reasons for association with EU; the economic, political and social basis for association/integrations; SMEs role in the implementation process; the impact of the DCFTA for the Moldova's economy; the impact of DCFTA on the SMEs sector; the SMEs' perception about the DCFTA; and the SMEs' expectations and concerns about the DCFTA.
the following questions: How do SMEs perceive the DCFTA and the opportunities that it brings?
the following questions: 1) What is the impact of the EU-DCFTA on the Republic of Moldovan SMEs?;
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Republic of Moldovan SMEs should be prepared for DCFTA.
the Republic of Moldovan SMEs are ready and willing for integration into the European Union.
the Republic of Moldovan economy is not ready to be associated with the European Union.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Republic of Moldovan SMEs have to prepare to the DCFTA.
the EU has to take into account that the DCFTA is a complex process that needs a comprehensive and long-term strategy.
the Republic of Moldovais not ready yet to join the European Union.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SMEs play a key role in the development of the Republic of the Moldova.
SMEs in Moldova have to adapt and adjust to the new market conditions.
SMEs are important for the future of the Republic of the Moldova's economy, and the DCFTA can help to develop them.
